name: circuit-idle
description: F1-themed idle game with a pure, fully-tested TypeScript engine + Three.js dashboard. Live demo included.

paragraphs: A car/automation-themed idle/incremental game in the spirit of Antimatter Dimensions (AD) — a fully static web app that saves to localStorage, hostable anywhere (e.g. GitHub Pages) with no backend.

Stack: TypeScript · Svelte 5 · Three.js (WebGL hero scene + bloom) · Vite · Vitest · breakinfinity.js for arbitrary-precision numbers · GitHub Actions → Pages CI/CD. Highlights: a pure, UI-agnostic simulation engine (no DOM/storage coupling) · 4 stacked prestige layers · a procedurally-infinite R&D tree · 47 engine tests · two headless balance-simulation bots that verify the whole progression is reachable.

Status: the entire progression spine is built, tested, and validated for reachability. The guiding philosophy has been get the numbers right first, dress it up second — and the dressing-up has begun. Visuals v1 has shipped: the game now boots into a 3D F1-broadcast dashboard (Svelte UI + a Three.js hero scene of cars lapping a non-circular track, with bloom). The old text UI is still available behind an in-app "Text UI" button as a ground-truth dump. See "Visuals — v1 (shipped) & what's next" below.
